verdict.rationale: Issuing API credentials is a fair question for an LLM gateway and observability platform, but the evidence pack never documents scoped or least-privilege Helicone keys. Custom rate limits, managed provider keys and BYOK are adjacent controls that limit usage or supply provider access, not permission-scoped credentials for an agent, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
